items.title: John Levy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: there was Eddie South, who was also a jazz player, but he was like a gypsy violinist.

ctx.x: What would he do? What would he do, for example, that would amaze you?

He was a great jazz violinist, just played – he played violin like trumpet players blow a horn or something. He didn’t play it like the instrument is created for. He would – there was Eddie South, who was also a jazz player, but he was like a gypsy violinist. He played the classics. A lot of the so-called jazz violin players were more like gypsy players on the violin, but Stuff Smith was just an out and out swinging jazz player, harmonically, in every kind of way. Nobody played the violin. Nobody attacked it.…
The Onyx packed would have about how many people?
